Emily / Markus —

Quick follow-up from our side with the artifact gating checklist Kimberly will use to assemble the packet. Marking high-priority asks so we don't get stuck on one item:

HIGH-PRIORITY (please provide if available)
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest 12 months) or SOC 2 assertion letter
- KMS key rotation logs (sample showing rotation event and who initiated it)
- Artifact showing encryption-in-transit configuration (load balancer / TLS config)
- Retention policy excerpt and a sample deletion/retention ticket

SECONDARY (helpful but not blocking)
- Telemetry sample: 24-hour trace logs with timestamps (redacted PII acceptable)
- Incident response runbook excerpt and most recent postmortem redaction

A couple of clarifications for scope: we typically provide "representative" artifacts (sample logs, redacted tickets). For encryption key provenance, a signed KMS export isn't possible, but we can provide console audit entries and rotation proof.

If you confirm the upload link I will start placing items in the evidence folder and tag them to the SIG question IDs.

Attachments: evidence_gating_checklist.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
